box.rationale: 8.0%-30.0%: the deepest development-window declines from the rolling 74-session high range from 34% (XLY) to 62% (XLE), with 2018 and 2022 declines of 20-37% on every ticker; the lower end admits ordinary sector pullbacks, the upper end still arms in 2020 on every ticker and is the engine grid ceiling (30.0%).
0.1%-5.0%: from an almost immediate rebound confirmation to a rebound larger than a typical day.
3.0%-15.0%: tighter than one day of sector-ETF noise up to twice D1 (7.3%).
3-30 calendar days before the loss exits apply (D1: 8).
20-250 sessions of reference high (D1: 74); 250 is one trading year, complete by the eligibility session.
0.0%-6.0% net loss for the buffered intraday exit (D1: 2.9%); 0% sells at the first net loss from the hold day.
10-200 sessions of continuation window after a profitable exit (D1: 60).
